Message:
Sign in with Apple, Google, Microsoft, and passkeys; self-service account deletion

- OIDC code flow (PKCE for Google and Microsoft, Apple form_post with an
  ES256 client secret); ID tokens verified against provider keys
  (signature, issuer, audience, expiry, nonce) and bound to the browser
  that started the flow.
- Only provider-verified emails match or create accounts; Microsoft
  work/school emails count only with xms_edov. Linking needs a session.
- Passkeys (WebAuthn, discoverable credentials) with origin, RP ID,
  challenge, and counter checks; no dependencies.
- My Account lists and manages sign-in methods and can delete the
  account. /app-sign-in hands a website sign-in to the app through a
  one-time code and PKCE verifier (/api/native-auth/exchange).
- Provider buttons appear only once their keys are set in Cloudflare.
- Migration 0011; the deploy now applies new D1 migrations first.
- Privacy policy and docs/sign-in-providers.md updated.
